name: Stack Rush
description: Tap to drop the sliding block; overhang gets cut. Land perfect drops to keep width and build combos.
market_notes: Stacker-style games are proven hyper-casual hits (Stack, Tower Bloxx) but extremely crowded; needs strong juice and themes.
readiness_notes: Core loop, combos, themes, coins, achievements, hard mode, daily reward + daily challenge, pause recap, mastery stats, mode-aware mastery goal chase HUD with visual progress meter, visible tolerance cue, directional live perfect/landing/miss timing cue, change-only screen-reader cue announcements, persistent accessible post-drop outcome and retained-width feedback, live perfect-rate and uninterrupted-streak feedback, date-scoped Daily PB feedback, corruption-safe local save normalization, safe-area touch-scrolling panels, offline cache-first web shell, semantic canvas board label, visible keyboard focus, active-overlay keyboard focus handoff, short-portrait HUD compression, ad hooks done. Missing: real ad integration, store screenshots, human playtest.
next_steps: Skyline Sprint btn-* owner art unused
Stack Rush: audio engine, more mastery content
Wire window.StackAdsNative to AdMob+UMP/ATT in Capacitor shell; restrict webDir to a www build

changelog.summary: Added keyboard focus handoff between menu, gameplay canvas, pause, continue, and game-over overlays; hidden actions no longer retain focus; syntax, logic, metadata, entry, and accessibility wiring checks pass; readiness 98->99.
Created game: stacking core loop, perfect combos, generated SFX, save, mute, Capacitor config.
Tutorial hint, coins, 4 unlockable themes, parallax starfield
Icon/splash/manifest icons, rewarded-ad continue (once per run, score>=5) with ad bridge hook
Generative music, pentatonic perfect-combo notes, interstitial hook every 3 runs
Perfect-drop shockwave ring + flash, score milestone callouts, visibility resume fix
Pause button/menu (auto-pause on background), alternating block entry side, block gloss/shade
Daily streak reward + rewarded double-coins on game over; dailyReward logic+test
6 achievements with coin rewards + toasts, Capacitor haptics bridge
Difficulty: speed ramps to 4.2 past score 40, perfect window shrinks 0.025->0.012; sim.js bot shows skill-gated scores (80/49/27 avg).
Hard mode: 0.6 start width, no regrow, 1.25x speed, 0.7x perfect window, separate best; sim avg 80/49/27 -> 42/23/12.
Daily Challenge: 5 rotating modifier sets, streak coin bonus, separate best, sim-verified harder than classic.
Surge mechanic: block speed warps within each sweep from score 25 (15 hard); sim skilled avg 80 -> 62 classic
+6 achievements (12 total): Combo x20, Score 150, Hard 15/30/50, Daily 25; tested
